answer: Farming becomes an onyx bet on surviving 112 epochs of grading, and every delta settlement recomputes the vine schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 112 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 5 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
